presetRows.note: Each admitted RZ09-0581 pair destination (managed PerformancePreset 0..4) with its own requested value; replace the segment's requested value, intent and destination together. Refused values keep a valid digest and must still be denied.

customRows.note: Custom (5) rows carry the requested CPU/GPU settings and run the pair then the CPU and GPU 0D/07 setters: progress 0, 1-4, 7-10, then 5. Both readers admit exactly the admitted journals.

boundary.note: A row carries the caller's requested settings, CPU Boost (3), GPU High (2) and maximum fans included, while its destination comes from the selected policy: both readers admit the complete journal with these settings.

hyperBoostExitRows.note: Leaving HyperBoost for a battery preset (managed PerformancePreset 3 or 4) journals the restore pair as progress 80-83 before the battery pair: 0, 80-83, 1-4, then 5. Rows 80-83 never settle. Readers that do not admit the restore sequence refuse every journal here; readers that do admit exactly the admitted ones.
